PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2027 Kenworth T280, T380, T680, T880, and W990 vehicles. The drivelines may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, causing the bearing cup to separate from the driveline.

Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Commander, Warrior, and 2021, 2024-2025 Avenger emergency vehicles equipped with a Bussmann mini fuse box. The fuse box may not have the correct amperage capacity, causing it to overheat.

Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2017, 2020-2026 Utilimaster Upfit vehicles. The tire and loading label may not list the combined weight value. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard Number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
